title: Optimizing Business Central Indexes for Performance with Copilot
summary: The post shows how to export the Database Missing Indexes table to Excel and use a Copilot prompt to generate AL tableextension index recommendations. It then advises benchmarking with the Performance Profiler before and after, applying only about five indexes at a time, and weighing faster reads against slower writes, especially on GL Entry.
key_points: Export the Database Missing Indexes table and use Copilot to generate AL code recommendations prioritized by estimated benefit
Benchmark system performance before and after applying indexes, measuring both read and write operations
Implement indexes incrementally (5 or fewer at a time) and wait several hours between applications to evaluate impact
Balance query performance gains against write performance costs, especially for high-volume tables like GL Entry
features: Copilot prompt for AL index generation

quotes.text: Remember Indexing improves data retrieval at the cost of data writes. This is of primary concern with indexing the GL Entry table.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the critical trade-off to consider when optimizing indexes, especially for financial tables

quotes.text: We aren't going to blindly implement AI Generated Code just because some blogger told you to, right?
quotes.why_it_matters: Emphasizes the importance of testing and validation before applying any generated code to production
